why: Every v3 route reads these stores and the API client; they are framework-bound (createSearchStore, persisted state, externalField, commands, router redirect), so they are rewritten, not moved.
what: window-stores (9 stores), timer-store, timer-tick, gym-profile, telemetry, use-field, use-now, eden, auth, shot-state, and byte-identical copies of the seven leaf modules the stores import.
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.1-6.3, argo DESIGN.md and the managed layer (.claude/rules/basalt-v3-*.md, skills basalt-v3-*). The installed basalt-ui is exact 3.0.0-next.N: its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth. Never import apps/dashboard; share through @argo/shared. Order: shared, state-features, state-stores, queries, shell, routes; a later Issue's import is a signal, never a stub. Controls law: concepts/controls-url-state.md (widget state in the URL, URL-field persist removed; decide about 20 fields one by one, in a comment). The seven leaf modules import nothing framework-bound (verified): copy them byte-identical; route Issues must_not_touch them.
exemplar: Installed docs/recipes for defineControls and createSyncedState; old tests lib/{window-stores,timer-store,gym-profile,auth,shot-state}.test.ts.
change: window-stores.ts: the nine createSearchStore stores (garmin, strength, bodyComp, walking, usage, astro, calendar, fin, models) become defineControls with field codecs; usageStore aliases and finStore's 17 fields keep their URL names. timer-store: zustand stays, `emit` moves to defineCommands, `externalField` to the v3 one. gym-profile: createSyncedState (or the recipe if spike-synced landed as recipe) over the gym settings query. telemetry on the v3 provider event hook. eden, auth, shot-state port with their tests (auth redirects through the v3 router). Rule: the controls family runs over window-stores; no store reads the URL outside defineControls.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: Golden URL fixtures: the same query strings decode to the same values in old and new stores for every retained field.
acceptance: `bun --cwd apps/dashboard-v3 test src/lib` exits 0; window-stores.test.ts has one golden URL fixture per store
`bun scripts/check-test-port.ts apps/dashboard/src/lib apps/dashboard-v3/src/lib --only '{timer-store,gym-profile,auth,shot-state}*'` exits 0 for timer-store, gym-profile, auth, shot-state
`diff` of each of the seven leaf copies against its apps/dashboard original prints nothing
each of the nine stores has a comment listing which fields stay in the URL and which move to session or device state
out_of_scope: Queries, features, routes, the settings sync server contract, the workout draft (stays app code).
